title: 17beta-Hydroxysteroid dehydrogenases 1 and 2: potential markers for breast cancer recurrence and tamoxifen resistance among premenopausal women diagnosed with breast cancer in Denmark.
authors: Collin, Lindsay J; Woolpert, Kirsten M; Kjaersgaard, Anders; Ahern, Thomas P; Goodman, Michael; McCullough, Lauren E; Waller, Lance A; Christensen, Kristina B; Damkier, Per; Hamilton-Dutoit, Stephen J; Lauridsen, Kristina L; Christiansen, Peer M; Ejlertsen, Bent; Sorensen, Henrik T; Cronin-Fenton, Deirdre P; Lash, Timothy L
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估乳腺癌中HSD17B1/2表达与复发及他莫昔芬耐药性的关联，纯临床队列统计与免疫组化，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Premenopausal women diagnosed with estrogen receptor (ER)-positive breast cancer are prescribed 5-10 years of tamoxifen therapy to prevent or delay a recurrence. The enzymes 17beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase 1 and 2 (HSD17B1 and HSD17B2, respectively) regulate the relative concentrations of estrogen metabolites and may modify tamoxifen effectiveness. We evaluated the prognostic and predictive value of HSD17B1 and HSD17B2 expression in breast tumors. METHODS: We identified a cohort of premenopausal breast cancer patients from the Danish Breast Cancer Group database (2002-2011) and stratified on ER status and receipt of tamoxifen (4600 ER+/TAM + and 1359 ER-/TAM-). Biomarkers HSD17B1 and HSD17B2 were assayed by immunohistochemistry. We used Cox proportional hazards regression to compute the hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% simulation intervals (SIs) associating each biomarker with recurrence, with bias adjustment to account for mismeasurement of biomarker expression and baseline selection bias from tumor sample availability. RESULTS: Among ER+/TAM + breast cancers, 24% had any HSD17B1 expression compared with 13% of ER-/TAM - breast cancers. In the bias-adjusted analyses, women diagnosed with tumors positive for HSD17B1 expression had a slight increased rate of recurrence: HR = 1.13 (95% SI 0.90, 1.43) in the ER+/TAM + stratum and HR = 1.15 (95% SI 0.77, 1.79) in the ER-/TAM - stratum. A 10-unit increase in HSD17B2 expression corresponded with a decrease in the estimated rate of recurrence among ER+/TAM + patients (HR = 0.85, 95% SI 0.69, 1.05), but not among ER-/TAM - patients (HR = 1.07, 95% SI 0.82, 1.42). CONCLUSIONS: HSD17B1 may be a prognostic marker for recurrence and HSD17B2 may be predictive of response to tamoxifen therapy in breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：被诊断为雌激素受体（ER）阳性的乳腺癌绝经前女性，通常接受5至10年的他莫昔芬治疗，以预防或延缓复发。17β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶1和2（HSD17B1和HSD17B2）调节雌激素代谢物的相对浓度，并可能影响他莫昔芬的疗效。我们评估了乳腺肿瘤中HSD17B1和HSD17B2表达的预后和预测价值。方法：我们从丹麦乳腺癌组数据库（2002-2011年）中确定了一组绝经前乳腺癌患者队列，并根据ER状态和他莫昔芬接受情况分层（4600例ER+/TAM+和1359例ER-/TAM-）。通过免疫组织化学检测生物标志物HSD17B1和HSD17B2。我们使用Cox比例风险回归计算风险比（HRs）和95%模拟区间（SIs），将每种生物标志物与复发相关联，并进行偏倚调整，以考虑生物标志物表达的测量误差和肿瘤样本可用性导致的基线选择偏倚。结果：在ER+/TAM+乳腺癌中，24%有HSD17B1表达，而ER-/TAM-乳腺癌中为13%。在偏倚调整分析中，诊断为HSD17B1表达阳性肿瘤的女性复发率略有增加：ER+/TAM+层中HR = 1.13（95% SI 0.90, 1.43），ER-/TAM-层中HR = 1.15（95% SI 0.77, 1.79）。HSD17B2表达每增加10个单位，与ER+/TAM+患者估计复发率降低相关（HR = 0.85，95% SI 0.69, 1.05），但在ER-/TAM-患者中无此关联（HR = 1.07，95% SI 0.82, 1.42）。结论：HSD17B1可能是乳腺癌复发的预后标志物，而HSD17B2可能预测他莫昔芬治疗的反应。
